liebermann.notes: Paper manuscript once owned by Francis Tate, with Pseudo-Cnut de foresta (f. 284); with Cii it goes back to cis, a common source posited by Liebermann.

entries.text_de: British Museum Stow 414, einst Fr. Tate gehörig, Papierhandschrift Ende 16. Jhs.; f. 284 Ps Cn for, u. S. 620. Die Hs. geht mit Cii auf ein verlorenes cis zurück.
entries.text_en: British Museum Stow 414, once belonging to Fr. Tate, paper MS of the end of the 16th century; f. 284 Ps Cn for, below, p. 620. The MS goes back, together with Cii, to a lost cis.

notes.text: Paper manuscript once owned by Francis Tate, with Pseudo-Cnut de foresta (f. 284); with Cii it goes back to cis, a common source posited by Liebermann.
